title: Customer experience survey – online shop (200 respondents)
text: An online fashion shop surveyed 200 customers after their last purchase. The answer distributions for three questions are shown below.

CSAT question: "How satisfied were you with your purchase?" (1 = very dissatisfied … 5 = very satisfied)
NPS question: "How likely are you to recommend us to a friend?" (0 … 10)
CES statement: "The company made it easy for me to handle my issue." (1 = strongly disagree … 7 = strongly agree)

title: Basket sizes of eight customers
text: A store manager records the number of items in the baskets of eight randomly selected customers: 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9.

title: Food-delivery app – survey of ten customers
text: A food-delivery app asked ten customers five questions after their last order: (1) Gender (female / male / diverse); (2) Age group (18–24 / 25–34 / 35+); (3) Number of orders in the last month; (4) "How satisfied are you with the app?" on a 7-point Likert scale (1 = very dissatisfied … 7 = very satisfied); (5) "Rank the following features from most to least important: price, delivery time, choice of restaurants."
The answers to question 3 are shown below. The Pearson correlation between the number of orders and satisfaction is r = 0.58.
